result:
All 617 tests pass and typecheck is clean. The fix addresses all three reported issues:

1. **Toggle not sticking**: `updateEndpoint()` in `webhook-repository.ts` had `...(input.enabled && { enabled: input.enabled })`, which spread nothing when setting `enabled: false` (falsy short-circuit) — the field was silently dropped, so an endpoint could never be switched off. Fixed to check `=== undefined`. Also added the missing toggle action (`src/actions/webhooks/toggle-webhook.ts`) and wired it into the settings UI/page so admins can actually flip the switch. The enqueue path already skipped disabled endpoints, so no new deliveries are queued once toggled off.

2. **Stale queued deliveries**: the delivery job looked up the endpoint but only checked whether it existed, not whether it was still enabled. Added an `enabled` check in `webhook-delivery-job.ts` that marks the delivery failed (and increments `result.failed`) when the endpoint has been switched off, mirroring the existing "endpoint no longer exists" branch.

3. **Quota bypass via disabling**: `createWebhook()` in `webhook-service.ts` only counted `enabled` endpoints against the plan limit, so switching one off freed up a slot. Changed it to count all endpoints regardless of enabled state.
